Line references below use the line numbers in the supplied snippets.

## 1. Data flow: raw load → preprocess → features → train → predict → submission

There are several pipelines. Only some produce a submission CSV; many `experiment*.py` files only compute CV AUC.

### A. Main final CatBoost submission pipeline: `run_final_submission.py`

| Stage | File / function | Lines | What happens |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Load raw data | `run_final_submission.py::main()` | L110-L116 | Reads `train.csv` and `test.csv`; converts `Churn == "Yes"` to binary `y`; creates `X` and `X_test`. |
| Preprocess / categorical schema | module constants | L22-L30 | Defines seeds/folds/checkpoints and `CAT_COLS`. |
| Feature engineering | `add_features(df)` | L52-L60 | Adds `avg_monthly_spend`, `charge_ratio`, `num_services`, `tenure_x_monthly`. |
| Fold target encoding for CV | `add_te_fold(tr, va, cols, ytr, smooth=20.0)` | L74-L84 | Smoothed target encoding fit on fold train, applied to fold train/validation. |
| Full-train target encoding for test | `add_te_full(tr, te, cols, ytr, smooth=20.0)` | L62-L72 | Smoothed target encoding fit on all train labels, applied to train/test for final model. |
| CV training | `main()` | L123-L149 | 7 seeds × 5-fold `StratifiedKFold`; fits `CatBoostClassifier`; records OOF AUC and best iterations. |
| Full-data training | `main()` | L159-L178 | Fits CatBoost on all training rows using full-train target encodings. |
| Prediction | `main()` | L180-L191 | For each checkpoint iteration, copies model, `shrink(cp)`, predicts test probabilities, averages over 7 seeds. |
| Submission CSV + Kaggle submit | `main()` / `submit_to_kaggle()` | CSV L198-L207; API L86-L
